messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty triggered HIGH for inference-gateway-eu-west1 — 5xx rate 4.6% over 5m (threshold 1%). Pager: PD12345. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/PD12345
sam (oncall): ack :rotating_light: I'm on it, taking the page. Starting triage.
pagerduty: Incident PD12345 acknowledged by sam (oncall)
jess (sre): seeing a spike in 502s from proxy layer. Any deploys in last 30m?
nina (platform): none in prod-eu-west1. Dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/inference/gateway?region=eu-west1 — p50 ~ 80ms, p95 jumped to 1.2s, error-rate 5xx=4.6%
kate (sre-infra): tailing edge-proxy logs — lots of backend_conn_reset and 502s, looks like upstream pods returning 502 with body 'KV cache miss overflow'
sam (oncall): running quick checks — curl health and a few requests
sam (oncall): ```bash
curl -i -H 'x-api-key: ****' https://inference-gateway.eu-west1.redwood/api/v1/health
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
X-Upstream-Errors: 0
```
jess (sre): grabbing app logs from a sample pod
jess (sre): ```
2026-03-15T02:23:05Z ERROR handler.go:312 response=502 upstream=kvcache region=eu-west1 msg="kv cache eviction: write queue full"
2026-03-15T02:23:12Z WARN  proxy.go:211 conn_reset client=10.2.1.45 upstream=10.4.5.12
```
nina (platform): looks like KV cache is getting overwhelmed — autoscale didn't spin up fast enough due to pod startup throttling
kate (sre-infra): I'm going to manually scale the kv-cache deployment and bump gateway replicas
kate (sre-infra): `kubectl scale deploy/kv-cache -n prod --replicas=4`
kate (sre-infra): `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway -n prod --replicas=6`
sam (oncall): I'll reroute high-volume customers to eu-west2 as a short-term mitigation. Runbook: https://go/runbooks/5xx-spike
leo (customer-success): flagging top 3 customers in eu-west1 and notifying account teams. Preparing status note.
sam (oncall): temporary suppress noisy PD alerts for this incident — pdctl silence PD12345 --minutes=15
sam (oncall): ```bash
pdctl incidents silence PD12345 --minutes 15
```
jess (sre): confirming scaling applied; pods starting, pulling image, 2/4 ready
kate (sre-infra): patching rate-limiter — increasing burst allowance for gateway to avoid backpressure
kate (sre-infra): `kubectl apply -f rate-limiter-patch.yaml -n prod`
nina (platform): KV cache replicas up, watchers show reduced eviction spikes. Error-rate dropping: now 5xx=1.2%
sam (oncall): reroute confirmed for 20% of traffic to eu-west2 via traffic-router: `trafficctl shift --service inference-gateway --from eu-west1 --to eu-west2 --percent 20`
leo (customer-success): sending customer update draft: "We're aware of increased 5xx errors in eu-west1, mitigation in progress, reduced impact expected within 30m." Any objections?
jess (sre): lgtm
sam (oncall): paging escalation — if errors >2% for next 10m escalate to infra lead @nina
sam (oncall): monitoring for 10m window
incident-bot: Note: PD escalation policy will trigger if unacknowledged for 10m; currently acknowledged
kate (sre-infra): KB: plan follow-up: post-incident RCA focus on kv cache sizing and startup throttle
leo (customer-success): sending first status update now :email:
sam (oncall): marking this as P1, we'll keep the channel updated. Next check-in in 10m :thumbsup:
jess (sre): current metrics snapshot: p95=320ms, 5xx=0.9%, queue_length reduced
sam (oncall): closing PD silence in 5m if stable, and will update status page when fully resolved
nina (platform): creating infra ticket: #INC-2026-314 (kv-cache sizing + autoscale tuning)
leo (customer-success): noted — will follow up with customers once we have full resolution and RCA
sam (oncall): thanks team — great coordination. Leaving channel once on-call rotation takes over
pagerduty: Incident PD12345 resolved by sam (oncall) — status: Mitigated (follow-up tickets opened)
incident-bot: Incident thread closed. Summary: Root cause likely kv-cache saturation causing upstream 502s; mitigated via scale + rate-limiter patch + traffic reroute. Follow-ups: INC-2026-314, RCA doc: https://docs.redwood/rca/PD12345
